description:
A 40-year master electrician shows you how to do your own home electrical work — the safe way, the code-right way, the way a pro does it.

Hi, I'm Hank Reeves. I spent forty years as an electrician — new construction, remodels, service calls, and a long stretch as an engineer — and I've opened a lot of walls. Nearly every dangerous thing I found behind them was done by a homeowner who meant well and just never learned the one habit that would have kept them safe.

This handbook is the way I actually do the work, laid out plain, in the order I'd teach my own son. Not theory, not a scare campaign — the real thing: how to make a wire dead and prove it before you trust your life to it, how to wire a switch and an outlet so it's safe and it passes inspection, what's really going on inside your panel, how to hook up a generator without hurting anyone, and exactly where the line is that you hand the job to a licensed electrician.
